findings.title: Brain marks a sheet's row change as seen before validating it; a valid second row op is refused as ROW_CHANGE_PENDING when the first was invalid
findings.repair: Add the sheet to row_seen only after to_cell_edits succeeds for that op.

findings.title: With a row change pending, a Brain answer that includes another row op on that sheet is refused as a whole, dropping valid edits on other sheets
findings.repair: Pre-filter in OfficeBrain.plan using the draft's pending row sheets (report ROW_CHANGE_PENDING per op) or tell the Brain which sheets have a pending row change.

findings.title: PARTIAL: Excel save-card refusals raised at publish (STRUCTURE_NOT_SUPPORTED, FILE_OPEN_ELSEWHERE, CELL_NOT_EDITABLE) and other Brain refusal codes still shown as 'Refused: CODE (detail)' / 'CODE: detail'
findings.repair: Add plain-word entries for STRUCTURE_NOT_SUPPORTED, FILE_OPEN_ELSEWHERE, CELL_NOT_EDITABLE, NOTHING_TO_SAVE, RELOAD_REQUIRED, APPLY_FAILED in a2ui_hub _humanRefusal, and route all Brain refusal codes through _human with a plain fallback that does not lead with the code.

findings.title: OPEN: delete-rows card shows only 3 rows of what is deleted
findings.repair: Show all captured rows (up to the 50 in op['shown']) on the save card, or say exactly how many non-empty rows are removed.

findings.title: OPEN: Word editor refusals use presentation wording
findings.repair: Pass the edit kind to authoringErrorMessage and use document wording for docx.

findings.title: OPEN: Grants state (_by_id, added) mutated and iterated from request threads without a lock
findings.repair: Guard _by_id/added with a threading.Lock in add/get/revoke/add_folder/remove_folder/roots; iterate over a copy.

findings.title: OPEN and wider: _unlink_quietly chmods a temp/hold that is hard-linked to the published file, setting the saved file to 0600 on POSIX; Excel Save/Save as now use this path too
findings.repair: After a successful link publish, unlink the temp/hold without chmod (only clear read-only on Windows when unlink fails), or check st_nlink>1 and skip the chmod.
